appraisal_events.evidence: "qui est partisan enragé de Dreyfus?... Mon neveu Robert!... au Jockey, quand on a appris ces prouesses, cela a été une levée de boucliers, un véritable tollé. Comme on le présente dans huit jours…"
appraisal_events.explanation: News of Robert's fervent Dreyfusism provokes a collective uproar among the Jockey Club membership just as his own admission there is pending, putting his reception in serious jeopardy.

status_effects.explanation: His reputation among the Jockey Club membership is damaged, provoking open collective outrage ('un véritable tollé') over his Dreyfusard views.
His pending admission to the Jockey Club, due in a week, is directly threatened by the uproar over his political stance.
